a root-radical owner that absorbs derivational, inflectional, article, particle, clitic, or pronoun material
a surface-only or normalized-only match offered as morpheme identity
a segmentation with no source-addressed occurrence evidence or with unresolved rivals hidden from the output
a combining mark detached from the base letter whose visible realization it modifies

every visible base letter has exactly one primary owner and any additional facts are secondary ownership only
all segment surfaces concatenate to the exact NFC written surface and every morpheme occurrence has a stable identifier

every emitted occurrence binds the unique loc and exact surface from qamus/indexes/quran-loc-surface/index.jsonl; the metadata recomputes and records the index, index manifest, producer inputs, schema and sample SHA-256 values, and any loc, surface or manifest-hash mismatch fails closed

root-radical, derivational, inflectional, stem, article, particle, clitic, and pronoun roles remain mechanically distinct when source-addressed evidence supports them; unsupported root ownership remains explicitly unresolved
rival segmentations, blockers, guards, and defeaters remain attached to the exact occurrence

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: If a letter owner, morpheme boundary, or role is not derivable from committed source-addressed evidence, emit an abstention with the exact missing dependency. Never infer identity from colour, surface resemblance, normalization, or shared root.
evidence_policy.statement: Ownership records are occurrence-bound mechanical projections of committed p007 pilot facts whose loc and exact NFC surface are independently acquired from the hash-verified canonical loc-surface index and manifest. Page-local surface is comparison-only and can never become canonical truth. The records preserve evidence addresses, rivals, guards, and candidate state without creating a new linguistic conclusion.

Red-first ownership, reconstruction, rivalry, and affix-boundary test suite

Pretty sorted metadata binding the canonical index and manifest, all producer inputs, schema, sample, counts, generator id and exact command by SHA-256
Measured scope, abstentions, and non-coverage report
Full regenerable candidate output kept outside tracked artifacts

guards: The METHOD transfers: exact occurrence binding, exact reconstruction, one primary letter owner, rival preservation, and abstention may be reused; no linguistic conclusion transfers to another occurrence.

SERIALIZATION 1 OF 2: run only after the integrated Burst A1 evaluation and consumer machinery is green; TP-SARF-PROJECTION-ELIGIBILITY-PARITY-W1 must wait for this packet's sample, schema, tests, and report.
The packet covers only the 12 committed pilot occurrences and must not be reported as corpus coverage.

For every selected occurrence, qamus/indexes/quran-loc-surface/index.jsonl is the exact loc and surface authority and index.manifest.json is the digest and edition contract. Recompute the index digest, require one row per loc, require exact NFC equality, and fail closed on missing, duplicate, mismatched or stale rows. A page-local surface is never canonical input.
One written base letter receives one primary visible owner; additional compatible facts remain secondary and never change the primary colour identity.
Combining marks travel with their owning base letter, and all indices are checked against the exact NFC surface.
Candidate and unresolved records stay candidate or unresolved; this packet never calls tools/certify_typed_fact.py and never changes a certification store.

Start only from a clean isolated worktree. Freeze HEAD before edits under out/sarf-occurrence-ownership-w1/start-sha.txt, retain that immutable start SHA, and compare both tracked and non-ignored untracked paths against the exact six-file repository allowlist. Git diff --check is a separate gate.

No existing A2 or A3 implementation file, canonical graph, eval bank, rule registry, entry data, website payload, tools/check_regressions.py, or docs/golden-commands.md is writable. Shared harness and golden-command registration is reserved for TP-PVN-REANCHOR-HARNESS-INTEGRATION-W1.

non_deployment.statement: All outputs are candidate-only repository artifacts. This packet does not certify a fact, author a public hover, mutate entry data, edit website code, or contact or mutate any live surface.

out_of_scope: Do not claim coverage beyond the 12 supported p007 pilot occurrences.
Do not decide a new root, morpheme boundary, lexeme, entry, sense, function, case, mood, referent, gloss, or translation.
Do not edit eval banks, rules, certification stores, canonical graph inputs, A2 or A3 lane files, website payloads, or live surfaces.
scope.summary: Produce the smallest candidate-only occurrence artifact that assigns every supported written letter to one primary morpheme owner while preserving exact surface reconstruction, distinct root and affix roles, rivals, evidence, blockers, and abstention.
